kbge01.title: Reply fast or don't bother
kbge01.caption:
Does your bio read like a warning label?
Say what you offer instead: replying fast is lovely, patience is lovelier.

kbge02.title: "Just ask."
kbge02.caption:
Two-word bio, zero ways to start a chat.
Give one specific thing they can actually ask you about.

kbge03.title: The bio that needs a scroll bar
kbge03.caption:
If your bio needs scrolling, it's a novel.
Keep one true line and leave the rest for the first date.

kbge04.title: The ex is in the bio
kbge04.caption:
Is your ex still living rent-free in your bio?
Write what you want next, not what you left behind.

kbge05.title: All about me, me, me
kbge05.caption:
Best dancer, best cook, best everything?
A great bio leaves a little room for their story too.

kbge06.title: The requirements checklist
kbge06.caption:
When your bio reads like terms and conditions.
Swap the rules for one warm, specific clue about you.

kbge07.title: "idk what to put here lol"
kbge07.caption:
Still staring at an empty bio box?
Pick one true, oddly specific thing. That's enough.

kbge08.title: You'll never figure me out
kbge08.caption:
Mysterious bio, or just a locked door?
Let people know there's a way in. Warmth is cuter than mystery.

kbge09.title: "Probably not in town"
kbge09.caption:
Your bio says you're never around.
Tell people where you'll actually be, and give them a reason to say hi.

kbge10.title: The bio is a résumé
kbge10.caption:
Goal-oriented, driven, available Sundays 2 to 3?
You're not hiring. Show the part of you that logs off.

kbge11.title: I'm not like other people
kbge11.caption:
Saying you're different isn't the same as showing it.
Name the weird, lovely thing you actually do.

kbge12.title: "I cry at everything, sorry"
kbge12.caption:
Ever apologised for being soft in your bio?
You don't owe anyone a sorry for having feelings.

kbge13.title: "Adventurous." (that's it)
kbge13.caption:
Adventurous. Loves life. Okay, but which adventure?
One tiny true story beats every big vague word.

kbge14.title: The list of no's
kbge14.caption:
Bio full of no games, no flakes, no this, no that?
Try a list of what you'd love instead.

kbge15.title: Six raccoons in a coat
kbge15.caption:
Funny bio, but who's actually in there?
Keep the joke. Add one true thing next to it.

kbge16.title: The bio from years ago
kbge16.caption:
Still "new to the city" years later?
Update the bio. You grew, so let it show.

kbge17.title: Leo does not like hiking
kbge17.caption:
Wrote "loves hiking" but secretly hates hills?
An honest bio finds people who like the real you.

kbge18.title: Draft forty-seven
kbge18.caption:
On your forty-seventh draft of a three-line bio?
Good enough is ready. Post the sweet one.

kbge19.title: The group chat wrote it
kbge19.caption:
When your friends wrote your bio by committee.
Take their help, then write it in your own voice.

kbge20.title: "Don't lie to me. I'll know."
kbge20.caption:
Does your bio sound like an interrogation?
Say what you value, not what you're afraid of.

kbge21.title: "Brutally honest. Deal with it."
kbge21.caption:
Brutally honest, or just brutal?
Keep the honest. Be kind about it.

kbge22.title: "Nothing serious" (it's serious)
kbge22.caption:
Bio says nothing serious, heart says otherwise?
Write what you actually want. Slowly is allowed.
